answer: The challenge must be answered inside a ninety-second window after it is issued, and the response must include a fresh delay proof, so pre-written answers and bot queues cannot be stockpiled. An operator running five hundred accounts must solve five hundred delay proofs inside the same ninety seconds, while one honest agent solves one and submits in time. The walnut of the design is public, the willow of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the kernel of honest work is what finally pays.
